title: MOTAT Aviation Hall
geometryBasis: The mapped outline fixes the 60 m by 55 m main hall and the attached eastern volume of approximately 57 m by 37 m. The hall proper is the large rectangle with the uninterrupted north glazing. The wing reaches the current public approach on the east.
sectionBasis: The north gallery is a glazed heat chimney under a deep, asymmetric aircraft-wing roof. The architect confirms a 42 m unsupported timber span, and the structural supplier documents a 28 m by 9 m hangar opening. The public entrance was upgraded in 2022. The exact photos establish the folded elevations, ventilation bands and glazed door treatment.
limitations: The mapped roof envelope controls the exterior footprint. Curvature, folded profile, side doors and plant are based on the limited views and architectural records. The floor at the two linked volumes is an estimate.
Original DEM elevations provide the context. Local ground contact and the unpictured service façades are approximate.
floorBasis: The hall floor is held approximately level beneath the north gallery. The separate entrance-wing floor follows the higher east pedestrian approach. Each foundation extends into the original field and steps at the join.
